description: This file defines table columns and related components for rendering logs and audit log entries with React, utilizing libraries such as @tanstack/react-table, @tremor/react, and antd. It includes data types, helper functions, and UI components like JSON viewer and copy-to-clipboard functionality.

classes.name: LogEntry
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the structure of a log entry object used in the columns for displaying detailed log information.

classes.name: AuditLogEntry
classes.description: TypeScript type representing an audit log record with metadata about changes, timestamps, and affected objects.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Utility function to format various message types into string for display.

methods.name: RequestResponsePanel
methods.description: React component for showing request and response JSON data with copy functionality and collapsible detail view.

methods.name: CollapsibleJsonCell
methods.description: React component to toggle visibility of JSON data within a cell, showing a preview with expand/collapse.

methods.name: getActionBadge
methods.description: Creates a badge component indicating the action type for audit log entries.
